# cubepath_cdn_plans (Data Source)

Fetches available CDN plans.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `plans` (Attributes List) Available CDN plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `base_price_per_hour` (Number) Base price per hour.
- `custom_ssl_allowed` (Boolean) Whether custom SSL certificates are allowed.
- `description` (String) Plan description.
- `max_origins_per_zone` (Number) Maximum origins per zone.
- `max_rules_per_zone` (Number) Maximum rules per zone.
- `max_zones` (Number) Maximum number of CDN zones.
- `name` (String) Plan name.
